acceptance_predicates.description: TUI checks bounded toolchain, PTY, filesystem, and linker prerequisites before materializing dev.
Missing prerequisites show stable human/JSON remediation and retry, cleanup, and rollback remain usable.
Host limitations are distinct from product failures.
Provider auth, production signatures, and key management are not required in development mode.

definition_of_done: Exact-head TUI preflight and recovery checks pass.
Independent review accepts host limitation classification and paired evidence.

inputs.description: Disposable host and exact paired heads.

outputs.description: TUI host preflight and recovery receipt.

gates.description: Preflight failures are typed, bounded, recoverable, and accurately classified.
